lead_raw_text:
The structure of MnAg₂S₃ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4₁/a (No. 143), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag centers with two S neighbors at 2.6783 Å, while Mn adopts a tetrahedral environment of four S neighbors at 2.3517 Å. The S sites are each coordinated by three Ag and one Mn, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner-sharing between Mn tetrahedra and between Mn tetrahedra and 12-vertex S coordination polyhedra.
